subject: Invoice creation: portal vs. emailed PDF — reconciliation and VAT evidence
messages:
From: Lynn Park <ap@brightsidehealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts-payable@brightsidehealth.com
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery options and PO (Brightside PO 7782)

Hi Hannah,

We just closed the onboarding for the Redwood Dedicated pilot and I need to confirm how you'll be sending invoices going forward. Our AP team prefers invoices pushed into our portal (Coupa) with the PO matched, but some of our stakeholders want an emailed PDF copy for internal review.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: (1) send via Coupa e-invoicing with the PO attached, and (2) copy our AP inbox with a PDF for our records? Also, we need VAT evidence for our compliance team — is that something you can attach to the invoice or provide separately?

Attaching our PO for your reference: Brightside_PO_7782.pdf (attachment).

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation, we have 30-day payment terms on this one.

Best,
Lynn Park
Accounts Payable Manager
Brightside Health
ap@brightsidehealth.com

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Lynn Park <ap@brightsidehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options and PO (Brightside PO 7782)

Hi Lynn — thanks for sending the PO and welcome aboard.

Short answers: yes to both, with one small caveat. Redwood supports coupled e-invoicing to Coupa (we can push the invoice and include the PO number so your AP can auto-match). We can also send an emailed PDF to accounts-payable@brightsidehealth.com as a copy.

Caveat: for Coupa pushes we need your Coupa supplier ID and the invoice receiver endpoint (or your AP team can allow push from supplier id redwood-inference). If you prefer we can route via SFTP / API instead — whatever your AP team prefers.

On VAT evidence: we can attach our invoice with a VAT summary table. If Brightside needs a separate VAT certificate upload, please send the required recipient for that document and we'll attach VAT_certificate_Brightside.pdf to the billing record.

Next steps from Redwood (proposed):
- Ben (cc'd) will prepare the invoice PDF and the Coupa push payload including PO 7782.
- Lynn, if you send your Coupa supplier ID and confirm the receiver endpoint, we will push this invoice into your portal and send a copy to your AP inbox.
- Marissa will follow up with a VAT evidence upload and DocuSign link for the payment schedule amendment (if needed).

Ben/Marissa — can you take this? I'll confirm once Brightside sends the Coupa details.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, Lynn Park <ap@brightsidehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 31 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options and PO (Brightside PO 7782)

Thanks Hannah — looping in billing ops.

Lynn, I generated the invoice for the pilot month (invoice_0426-Redwood.pdf) and am prepared to push via Coupa once you confirm supplier ID and receiver endpoint. I attached the PDF here for your internal routing and our records.

A few items I need from you to complete the portal push:
- Coupa supplier ID (e.g., BRIGHT-12345)
- Receiver endpoint URL or AP contact who can whitelist redwood-inference as a supplier
- Confirm whether you want the PDF as an invoice attachment in the Coupa payload or only sent to your accounts-payable inbox as a separate message

VAT: we can include the VAT line on the invoice and include a separate VAT evidence PDF in the billing record (I've attached a placeholder VAT_certificate_Brightside.pdf that we will replace once you upload the certificate).

Attachments: invoice_0426-Redwood.pdf (PDF)

If you prefer to avoid the portal and continue via email-only for the first quarter, we can do that and export a Coupa-ready XML whenever you're ready.

Best,
Ben Carter
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Lynn Park <ap@brightsidehealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts-payable@brightsidehealth.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options and PO (Brightside PO 7782)

Thanks Ben & Hannah — quick answers from AP:

- Coupa supplier ID: BRIGHT-7782 (confirmed)
- Receiver endpoint: supplier-invoices@coupa.brightsidehealth.com (please whitelist redwood-inference)
- Include the PDF both in the Coupa payload (as attachment) and send a copy to accounts-payable@brightsidehealth.com — internal reviewers need it.

I'll upload our VAT certificate to our vendor portal tonight and will send the PDF to you directly so you can attach it to the billing record. For speed we are fine if you email the current invoice and then do the Coupa push once the certificate is attached to your record.

Also, please send a DocuSign for the 30-day payment term confirmation amendment (we had a special rate for the pilot). I'll have our procurement sign that by EOD tomorrow.

Attaching VAT_certificate_Brightside.pdf (attachment).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — moving us to production next month.

Best,
Lynn
Accounts Payable Manager
Brightside Health
